<https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataset.xhtml?persistentId=hdl:1902.1/21919>

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data <- pres_elections_release |> 
  transmute(election_year,fips,county_name,state,
            democratic_raw_votes,republican_raw_votes, 
            winningParty=if_else(
              democratic_raw_votes >republican_raw_votes, 
              "Demoncratic",
              "Republican"
              ),
            voteDiff = abs(
              democratic_raw_votes-republican_raw_votes
              ),
            winningPercentage = voteDiff/raw_county_vote_totals 
            ) |> 
  filter(election_year > 1999)
```

```{r}
data |> 
 ggplot( aes(x=winningPercentage)) +
    geom_density(fill="#69b3a2", color="#e9ecef", alpha=0.8)
```

```{r}
colnames(pres_elections_release)
```

```{r}
write_csv(data,'./princetonData.csv')
```
